notes: Desk upper shelves reuse wardrobe RF0/RB0. Their top cross-pipe is shared with Rack.top0; opposing saddle straps are staggered.
No split end/middle holders are assumed. Toom 7450897 is the saddle reference; its exact dimensions remain preview fields.
Lowest desk shelf retains the custom MITTLED recess. No final routing/loads verified.
Four long-coat slots now use about 140 mm pitch each; bulky coats may require fewer slots. Hanging height remains unchanged.
V17 TV and all its custom support parts removed; the desktop TV bore is removed.
Each speaker board is a 350 x 350 x 25 mm oak tray on two uncut 250 mm cantilever arms, each clamped to its own upright by a sliding T. Four one-sided saddle tabs screw each tray to the arms.

Near wall tie raised from 1100 to 1200 mm to clear speaker-arm tees. Tray underside 1100, top 1125 mm before angled isolation pads. The arm tees cannot drop lower while the 1000 + 1200 mm posts keep their coupling at 1015-1027 mm, so the downward tweeter aim comes from the pads. No desktop speaker risers or flanges.

Trays rotate in the connection graph and their outside Y corners align with the two desktop ends. Speakers aim at the seated ear reference (x 2620, z 1220 mm), not the seat centre; angled pads tilt the tweeters down to that height. This wide stereo geometry is a visual arrangement, not a calibrated acoustic setup.
Cantilever capacity, clamp anti-rotation, saddle screw retention, speaker weight and fixing loads remain unverified. No positive manufacturer cantilever rating has been established.

Derived desktop underside 704 mm / top 732 mm. Front support legs terminate under the tabletop through elbows: no front-leg bores or protrusions. Four 44 mm preview clearance bores remain only for the continuing rack posts, including near-edge notches.
The desktop still measures 1615 x 702 x 28 mm in the same plan position. Main entry corner gap remains 640.9 mm. Closest modeled front foot clearance exceeds 600 mm.

Model connection and clearance checks are not a load certification. Verify desk saddle screws, clamp slip/rotation, wall anchorage and leaning loads before construction. Fully floating desk is not assumed approved.
V18 joint correction: two DOLLE 96384 four-female crosses at desk height join upper/lower upright, 250 mm front arm and 250 mm rear bridge. No capped rear arm or pipe passing through a solid upright.

The two cross-bearing posts use lower 602 + coupling + 40 mm, cross, then 40 + coupling + 1500 mm above. With the preview profile, their capped tops reach 2265 mm; boards, equipment and desktop retain their positions.

Two additional 250 mm low front braces join front legs to middle posts at 400 mm with sliding T fittings on both ends. Existing rear depth braces stay at 300 mm to avoid overlapping the two single-branch T sleeves.

The cross is a threaded fitting, not a slide-on clamp. Preassemble free modules and stage all sleeves before feeding posts; verify the physical closure sequence and measured socket stops before purchasing or cutting timber.

Rear equipment shelf: 1615 x 230 x 18 mm, underside 500 / top 518 mm. It begins 472 mm behind the desktop front; the middle knee zone remains open. Two 250 mm pipes at 485 mm connect to four sliding T fittings and four saddles; no new floor legs.
Low wall ties move from 450 to 400 mm to clear the 485 mm service-shelf sleeves. Low front braces stay at 400 mm on the other posts; rear braces stay at 300 mm.

M1 Mac mini 197 x 197 x 36 mm sits on the rear shelf with ports facing along its length for cable access. Router and power-brick sizes remain space allowances, not measured products. Keep the shelf open and separate the bricks; do not stack or strap across vents.

Focusrite and OWC dock use separate adjustable open-bottom/side U holders under the front ends. Their exposed front panels and cable reserves remain outside the 700 mm central seated knee width; bracket screw lengths and exact Focusrite generation remain to verify.

Portal variant: a floor-to-ceiling divider runs from the bar end to the right wall. Six new posts stand on the floor and the two near desk posts complete the frame, so no upright is doubled. Four ceiling ties and four wall ties hold it.
Board ends step along an ellipse 1360 mm wide and 1990 mm high above the floor, so the round door is hinted by the cut of the shelves. Nothing is curved.
Six KNAGGLIG crates sit 3 x 2 on the two lintel boards, long side across the room. Lintel heights are derived from the measured ceiling.

The desk module moves as one rigid block to stand behind the divider. The wardrobe becomes one 602 mm short bay and one 602 mm coat bay; folded clothes move onto the divider shelves and the wear-again rail is dropped.
Ceiling ties take up height through a sliding T, so a re-measured ceiling moves the tie and lintel without changing any stock pipe length.
Ceiling construction, anchors, cantilever arms and the 1,416 mm crate-loaded span are not load-certified; verify before building.

validation.scope: Connection graph, stock lengths, clamp separation, pipe intersections, board supports/bores; fitting surface meshes and structural loads not certified
